texts.en:
An impossible mental acceleration overwhelms our senses. We recognize the presence of the Black River.

We rush with incomprehensible speed towards a finality we do not fully grasp. It is the boundary between everything and nothing; the separation of what has always been and what never will be; the limit beyond which no natural law can extend.

Finally, as we return to ourselves, we are left with a new notion of what it means to truly move.

summary.text:
# 无限加速 / Infinite Acceleration

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:8124-8156`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5819-5854 (on_patron_delve_failed: 28 events × 100, utopia.3002 × 1)`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:8,109-114 (attunement ±50/100/200; 30-year retrigger 10800 days)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

潜入虚境但没有找到其他事件（on_patron_delve_failed）时，从28个权重各为100的遭遇（另有权重1的 utopia.3002 兜底）中随机抽取一个满足条件的；每次潜入失败只出现一个遭遇，不会依次经历全部。要求与小赞助者“幽黑之长河”已完成接触、未在“自寻出路”、处于喰煞或器具领域之一，每个帝国一次。

When a Shroud delve finds nothing else (on_patron_delve_failed), one eligible encounter is drawn at random from 28 candidates of weight 100 each (plus utopia.3002 at weight 1 as fallback); each failed delve shows one encounter, never all of them in sequence. Requires completed contact with the minor patron the Black River, not forging its own path, and being in the domain of the Eater or the Instrument; once per empire.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

幽黑之长河让我们以不可理解的速度奔向终局。

The Black River hurls us towards a finality we cannot grasp.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一选项：解锁法令“永动之意”。

Only option: unlocks the edict Will of Motion.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照原文核实了触发、选项与回复事件；草稿结构正确（选项→各自的回复窗口，互斥）。本遭遇与同池其他遭遇相互独立，不应串成一条故事。

Trigger, options and reply events were checked against the source; the draft structure is right (each option → its own reply window, mutually exclusive). This encounter is independent of the others in the pool and must not be chained with them.
